result.title: 水庫水情資料
result.description: 本資料集主要係彙整台灣地區現有公告之水庫，包含水庫名稱、水情時間、本日集水區累積降雨量、進流量、水位、滿水位、有效蓄水量、蓄水百分比、水庫出流量、防洪運轉狀態等資料。本資料集來源係由水利署水利防災組之災害緊急應變系統產出；由各水庫管理單位依水庫為自記儀器每小時自動產生或人工每日觀測一次，負責轉入或登錄（若遇颱風豪雨期間涉及防汛重點之水庫，需登錄每小時之累積降雨量、進流量、水位、滿水位、有效蓄水量、蓄水百分比、水庫出流量、防洪運轉狀態等資料）至水利署之系統內。本資料庫管理系統所提供之資料，主要為提供給關心台灣地區水庫水情之各界，了解目前水庫最新之水情變化，作為旅遊、經濟建設分析、學術研究、防災防汛及水源調配…等之依據。請使用者注意顏色設定，勿使用「綠色」、「黃色」、「橙色」及「紅色」，避免誤導社會大眾將水庫蓄水率與水情燈號不當連結，水情燈號請以水利署網站【https://www.wra.gov.tw/】為主。
result.notes:
1.受限於各水庫管理單位提供資料頻率不同，原則上每日更新1次。
2.水庫名稱可利用[ReservoirIdentifier]欄位對應"水庫每日營運狀況"資料集之[ReservoirName]欄位取得。
3.水庫水情歷史資料，可至水利署防災資訊服務網查詢，網址：https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/fhyv2/monitor/reservoir

授權說明網址: http://data.gov.tw/license。
Swagger 產生API說明頁面網址：https://opendata.wra.gov.tw/openapi/swagger/index.html
3.請使用者注意顏色設定，勿使用「綠色」、「黃色」、「橙色」及「紅色」，避免誤導社會大眾將水庫蓄水率與水情燈號不當連結，水情燈號請以水利署網站【https://www.wra.gov.tw/】為主。

en.title: Reservoir water level data
en.description: This dataset mainly compiles the existing reservoirs announced in Taiwan, including the reservoir name, water situation time, accumulated rainfall in the watershed today, inflow, water level, full water level, effective storage capacity, storage percentage, reservoir outflow, flood prevention operation status, and other data. The source of this dataset is generated by the Disaster Emergency Response System of the Water Resources Agency's Water Resources and Disaster Prevention Center. Each reservoir management unit generates or manually observes the data from the self-recording instruments in the reservoir every hour or once a day, and is responsible for inputting or logging the data into the Water Resources Agency's system. The data provided by this database management system is mainly for those concerned about the water situation of reservoirs in Taiwan to understand the latest changes in the water situation of the reservoirs, as a basis for tourism, economic development analysis, academic research, disaster prevention and flood control, and water resource allocation, and so on.
en.notes: 1. Limited by the different data update frequencies provided by each reservoir management unit, updates are generally made once daily.2. Reservoir names can be obtained by using the [ReservoirIdentifier] field to correspond with the [ReservoirName] field in the "Reservoir Daily Operations Status" dataset.3. For historical reservoir water data, please visit the Water Resources Agency Disaster Prevention Information Service website at: https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/fhyv2/monitor/reservoirAuthorization information website: http://data.gov.tw/license.API documentation conforming to the OAS specification: https://opendata.wra.gov.tw/openapi/api/OpenData/openapiSwagger-generated API documentation page: https://opendata.wra.gov.tw/openapi/swagger/index.html
